description: This dataset records observations from a Mackerel Trawl Survey, focusing on the species Scomber scombrus. It captures detailed spatial coordinates, bathymetric depths, and environmental conditions such as salinity and temperature at specific benthic habitats. Each entry includes precise timestamps and identifies individual fish by total length and count. The data supports marine biology research by linking biological measurements with oceanographic parameters. Users can analyze catch composition, habitat preferences, and environmental impacts on mackerel populations. The structured format allows for robust statistical analysis of trawl events, facilitating studies on fish distribution and ecosystem dynamics in coastal waters.
